$Comment: The Voidtaken Horseman, the restless graveyard's boss wave every fifth wave of its endless run: the Headless Horseman in the saddle as the void took him, his own look (Appearance Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted, the horse walking and galloping as he flies) wrapped in the void's glow, a Variant of Template_Flying_Aggressive like the Horseman's mounted forms. He flies the Horseman's ride with the void in it (Seasons_Of_Orbis_Voidtaken_Ride, CombatAdditionalBehaviorComponent, which runs Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Ride with void bombs on its bomb pass): dives to fight low (1 to 3 blocks up), wide high swings, laps of the fountain, swoops through a ringed spot and bomb passes, turning on the nearest player every 4 to 6 seconds unless his target is within TargetRange. MotionFlyMaxHeightAboveGround must clear the highest of the ride's points (laps and bomb passes 8 up, swings 8 or 9). Between moves he hurls a void bomb (Root_Seasons_Of_Orbis_Voidtaken_Bomb) at a player within 18 blocks, but only after aiming at them for 2 seconds (RangedAttackAimingRange, the game's own flier aim tell), then waits 3 to 4 seconds (RangedAttackPauseRange); it bursts in the void and leaves the ground burning, hurting players only. He has no party health steps: each return the run's ramp makes him tougher (the dungeon's Run.Endless.Ramp, per return). Nothing calls him back toward the plaza (the run sends no Orbis_Boss_Leash), so he follows his target anywhere in the graveyard. The void hurts him at half (Seasons_Of_Orbis_Voidtaken_Ward in _CombatConfig, which also gives him his glow), he is never shoved (KnockbackScale 0), dies in the void (DeathParticles Effect_Death_Void) and drops nothing (DropList Empty): his reward is what each boss wave banks into the run's chest. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.
